name: Hala A. Sandridge
tagline: Top rated Appellate attorney in Tampa, Florida
education: Florida State University College of Law
about: Hala A. Sandridge is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. She works at Buchanan Ingersoll & Rooney PC, located in Tampa, Florida, and provides legal services for issues involving Appellate to the surrounding community.
Hala Sandridge completed legal studies at Florida State University College of Law and graduated with the class of 1984. Hala Sandridge passed the bar in 1984.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
